research_question: Under the same verified SFT initialization and online action-token budget, does public-anchor step credit improve WebShop learning efficiency over trajectory-broadcast multi-turn GRPO?

webshop.role: original benchmark, task semantics, product and reward provenance

agent_r1_code.role: pinned WebShop FastAPI, SQLite and Lucene reference implementation

agent_r1_data.license: inherits original benchmark terms; research use with attribution; artifacts are not redistributed
agent_r1_data.role: official processed 1.18M-product runtime and 12087 task goals

dedup_contract.rule: retain every frozen test row; for dev and train, exclude a row when its normalized instruction occurred at any lower goal_index
dedup_contract.reason: the pinned source contains 203 later duplicate rows and raw cross-role exact-instruction overlap

dataset.test_contract: all unaltered official goals[0:500]; accessible before final evaluation only to a content-blind integrity and exact-duplicate isolation audit; never used for SFT, rollouts, tuning, checkpoint selection, or preflight metrics
dataset.dev_contract: 499 eligible goals from official indices 500:1000 after canonical-first exact-instruction isolation; configuration and checkpoint selection only
dataset.train_contract: 10885 eligible goals from official indices 1000:12087 after canonical-first exact-instruction isolation; deterministic cold coverage then signal sampling

sft.source: deterministic verified oracle replay against official train/dev goals
sft.selection_contract: scan the full eligible split in deterministic SHA256 order and retain the first requested number of public-action-valid, reward-1 oracle trajectories
sft.expert_contract: search goal.query; click goal.asin; select required goal_options; click Buy Now; retain only reward=1
sft.completion_contract: action-only compact JSON; completion-only loss; no hidden goal fields in prompts; no chain of thought
sft.plateau_selection: after at least two epochs and 250000 cumulative completion-label token exposures: dev NLL, schema-valid rate, exact action match, and 64-task closed-loop dev success; fail if three epochs cannot reach the token floor

online.baseline_credit: one standardized K=4 terminal advantage broadcast to all action turns
online.main_credit: macro advantage plus first-visit standardized discounted return at exact task-scoped public-state anchors; exact macro fallback elsewhere

anchor_contract.state_source: exact task-scoped public MDP state before action: schema, task id, instruction, page type, prompt-visible observation text, truncation flag, bounded available actions and terminal flag
anchor_contract.policy_context_evidence: exact prompt-token SHA256 is recorded separately and binds behavior logprobs but never changes the state group
anchor_contract.group_scope: same frozen task and same atomic K4 rollout group only

credit_parameters.advantage_normalization: population standardization within the same task K4 group; exact zero when standard deviation is at most epsilon
credit_parameters.loss_normalization: token mean within turn; turn mean within trajectory; trajectory mean within K4 group

online.recovery: fsync every generated turn and atomic K=4 group; commit adapter, rollout adapter, optimizer, sampler and token ledger per iteration; resume same root after 24h interruption

secondary_metrics: success by category and constraint count
evaluation.statistics: task-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals and paired seed-aware permutation tests
evaluation.test_open_policy: open exactly once after all seven adapter hashes and inference settings are frozen

preflight_gates.upstream_hash_and_count: all locked runtime files exact; 1181430 products; 12087 contiguous goals
preflight_gates.split_isolation: zero goal-index overlap and zero normalized exact-instruction overlap across the eligible train/dev rosters and the complete frozen test roster; exclusions must exactly match the versioned lock
preflight_gates.training_runtime: all pinned critical packages exact; RequestsDependencyWarning absent; pip check output contains only the frozen vLLM 0.17.0 versus Transformers 5.14.1 metadata exception; Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration is registered natively; real generation remains a required GPU gate
preflight_gates.expert_replay: 100 percent verifier success; zero invalid labels; zero test access; zero hidden-field prompt leakage
preflight_gates.base_signal: at least 32 K4 train groups; infrastructure-valid >= 0.99; mixed-reward group fraction >= 0.20; success in [0.03, 0.70]
preflight_gates.step_credit: the initial public state is shared in every valid K4 group; nonzero informative micro credit occurs in >= 0.02 of generated turns; >= 0.05 of valid groups contain a shared non-initial public state
preflight_gates.optimizer: at least two nonzero updates; finite loss and gradients; effective optimizer action-token fraction >= 0.15
preflight_gates.throughput: benchmark 32 and 64 lanes against one shared 8-CPU service; select the faster stable setting; generation-phase median GPU utilization >= 0.60 and learner-phase median GPU utilization >= 0.80; no OOM
preflight_gates.recovery: real Slurm interruption and same-root recovery preserve exact cost and artifact lineage
preflight_gates.formal_release: a clean frozen Git SHA plus a self-hashed readiness artifact must be referenced by a separate versioned authorization artifact; this preflight protocol remains closed until a new formal protocol version is reviewed

slurm.resume_policy: one logical run may require multiple 24h Slurm allocations; no fixed submission count is claimed

server_runtime.allocation_consistency: every service allocation audit content_sha256 must equal the setup audit

training_runtime.known_pip_check_exception: vllm 0.17.0 has requirement transformers<5,>=4.56.0, but you have transformers 5.14.1.
training_runtime.exception_scope: metadata-only exception accepted for preflight because vLLM 0.17.0 natively registers Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration; formal release still requires real deterministic generation, behavior-logprob, sleep/wake and learner-update gates

rejected_candidates.WebArena: recognized and closer to general websites, but the cluster has no Docker, Podman, Singularity or Apptainer; parallel mutable site stacks would dominate project scope and scheduler resources
rejected_candidates.Mind2Web: useful offline imitation data but no executable online reward environment; action and state distribution mismatch does not repair RL signal
rejected_candidates.AgentInstruct_WebShop: 351 trajectories have no explicit dataset license in the pinned card and local audit found overlap with the frozen WebShop test indices; excluded from every formal artifact
rejected_candidates.CUA_Gym: large recent visual CUA suite, but it changes model modality, action space and infrastructure simultaneously
rejected_candidates.MiniWebWork_v2: retained only as an auditable data-regime failure diagnostic; it is not a formal M5 benchmark or training source
